title: NASA-UAP-D016, Preliminary Gemini 4 Crew Debriefing, Part I, 1965
doc_notes: This document is a preliminary transcript of the Gemini 4 flight crew debriefing, focusing on mission operations and the EVA, with a specific mention of observed 'sparkles' in orbit. / This document is a preliminary transcript of the Gemini 4 crew debriefing aboard the USS Wasp, focusing on mission systems, EVA, and orbital observations.

incidents.summary: Astronaut Ed White observes 'sparkles' during the Gemini 4 flight.
incidents.explanation: The crew identified the particles as fuel vaporizing from the booster and spacecraft.
incidents.quote: I could see little sparkles everywhere.

incidents.summary: Astronauts McDivitt and White observed a planet (likely Venus) during the Gemini 4 flight, which they initially mistook for the booster rocket.
incidents.explanation: The astronauts concluded the object was Venus, which appeared to flicker due to atmospheric effects when low on the horizon.
incidents.quote: I spent one whole sunset doing nothing but keeping my eye out for that planet. Sure enough it popped up and I saw it.
